text:
The topology works and only two specs miss by small margins: vref is 0.6165 V against a 0.6402–0.6798 V window, and PSRR is 32.87 dB against 34 dB. Every other spec passes with margin, so refining the parameters should be enough.

- **vref:** raising `a` (sets R3) increases the divider ratio k, which lifts vref towards 0.66 V. I expect TC to change only slightly.
- **PSRR:** a larger gate-to-VDD cap `Cg` and a longer PMOS mirror length `Lp` (lower PMOS gds) should both improve PSRR at 1 kHz.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology works; vref 4% low and PSRR 1.1 dB short. Raise a (R3, divider k) to lift vref to ~0.66 V; larger Cg and longer Lp improve 1 kHz PSRR. Other specs have margin.",
 "params": {"a": 0.76, "Cg": 3.5e-12, "Lp": 10.0},
 "bounds": {"a": [0.70, 0.88], "Cg": [2e-12, 6e-12], "Lp": [6.0, 14.0]}}
```
